item.title: Reasoning models don't always say what they think
item.description: Since late last year, 'reasoning models' have been everywhere. These are AI models—such as Claude 3.7 Sonnet—that show their working: as well as their eventual answer, you can read the (often fascinating and convoluted) way that they got there.
